basic_profile.bio: A 25-year-old outdoor enthusiast from Boulder, Colorado, who's just taken up dirt jumping. By day, I'm a digital marketing specialist, helping brands boost their online presence. I'm single and often found exploring various trails during the weekends. Typically online in the evenings after work, I enjoy learning about new biking gear and techniques. I'm also a casual gamer, especially interested in Halo: The Master Chief Collection.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having recently picked up dirt jumping as a hobby, most of my knowledge comes from online research, YouTube tutorials, and advice from more experienced riders in various forums. My educational background is in marketing, but I've always had a knack for learning new sports.
